benefits: Support for up to 3 years (6th semester) of PhD study, subject to annual review of the student's academic progress
eligibility: PhD student from a country within Southeast Asia, South Asia, Central Asia, the Middle East or Africa
Not a recipient of any other scholarship or financial assistance and not engaged in any employment at the time of application
Published at least one article in an academic journal and/or received strong recommendations from academic institutions (e.g. Vice Chancellor, Dean, Director)
Holds a support letter from an advisor/supervisor
Holds a letter from the student's embassy verifying no financial assistance, scholarship or income from any agency or government
requirements: Priority to academic staff members of institutions that have MoUs with UPM who intend to conduct research in priority areas relevant to UPM/Malaysia
Open to new students and up to first-semester students with 'Continue' status
Number of scholarships awarded depends on application quality and funding availability
Incomplete or late applications will not be processed and any appeals will not be entertained
documents: Online application form completed via the SGS student portal
Letter from the student's embassy verifying no financial assistance, scholarship or income from any agency or government
Evidence of at least one journal publication and/or strong institutional recommendation letters
selection_criteria: Publication record and/or strong recommendations from academic institutions
Existence of an MoU/MoA between the applicant's institution and UPM
coverage: Duration up to 3 years (to the 6th semester), subject to annual review of academic progress
application_method: Complete the online application form via the student portal at http://sgsportal.upm.edu.my:8080/sgsportal/
Advisor/Supervisor and Dean/Director of Faculty/School/Institute must support the application online before or latest by 31 August 2026

official.international_eligibility: Open to international students only (International Graduate Student Scholarship)

official.research_requirement: Applicants must hold a support letter from an advisor/supervisor; priority is given to those intending to conduct research in priority areas relevant to UPM/Malaysia

official.description: The School of Graduate Studies, Universiti Putra Malaysia, awards the International Graduate Student Scholarship (IGSS) as a financial incentive for PhD students with excellent academic records from countries within Southeast Asia, South Asia, Central Asia, the Middle East and Africa, providing a 30-50% tuition fee waiver for up to three years.
official.program_type: University tuition waiver scholarship for PhD students

verification.notes: Verified against the official UPM SGS IGSS page (updated 02/07/2026): 30-50% tuition fee waiver for up to 3 years; no monetary figure or English requirement is published, and the 01-31 August 2026 window has closed.

applicant_utility.summary: UPM's IGSS waives only 30-50% of PhD tuition and nothing else, so you must fund the remaining tuition plus all living costs in Malaysia yourself. Eligibility is strict: you must already hold a master's degree, hold no other scholarship or financial assistance, and be unemployed at the time of application. Start the supervisor support letter and the embassy letter early, because both must be in place before the August window closes. Academic staff at institutions with an MoU/MoA with UPM receive priority, so independent applicants compete for a limited pool of awards.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Master's graduates from Southeast Asia, South Asia, Central Asia, the Middle East or Africa with at least one journal publication, no other funding, and no employment at application time.
application_readiness_checklist: Secure a supervisor's support letter before the application window opens
Obtain the embassy letter verifying you receive no financial assistance, scholarship or income from any agency or government
Gather proof of at least one academic journal publication or strong institutional recommendations
Confirm your Master's degree is already completed
Check whether your institution has an MoU/MoA with UPM so you can claim priority
Ensure your supervisor and Dean/Director can complete the online endorsement before the closing date
common_rejection_risks: Holding any other scholarship, grant or employment at the time of application
Missing the supervisor or Dean/Director online endorsement by the deadline
No journal publication and no strong institutional recommendation to show
Late or incomplete applications, which UPM states will not be processed and cannot be appealed
Applying without the embassy letter verifying no other financial support
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The remaining 50-70% of tuition plus all living, accommodation, insurance and travel costs in Malaysia
document_audit: The embassy letter must specifically verify no financial assistance, scholarship or income from any agency or government
The supervisor support letter must be lodged through the SGS portal, not sent informally by email
Publication evidence should be an actual academic journal article; a conference abstract alone is weak
